scenario.demo_disclaimer: Demo / synthetic scenario — not a live forecast or observation.
scenario.issued_at_note: Fixed scenario timestamp (intentional): the demo clock never moves, so 'Day +3' is always 2026-05-21 regardless of when you open the demo.
scenario.label: Humid dangerous heat — WBGT-driven severe risk
scenario.summary: Moist maritime air keeps Tmax at 35–38 °C — BELOW the IMD heatwave absolute threshold, so no heatwave episode is declared — but humidity of 68–82 % at peak drives estimated WBGT past 33–35 °C and the HTSI into Severe. Sweat stops evaporating; the dry-bulb number hides the danger.
scenario.tagline: Why temperature alone is not enough.
teaching_points: IMD Tmax label says None/Watch while thermal stress says Severe — read both
Wet-bulb physics: humidity dominates WBGT when radiation is modest
Health-impact indicator escalates from the thermal channel, not the heatwave channel
